supported_claims.notes: The implementation uses projects as the main workspace.
Five specialised AI-assisted stages are orchestrated in Python.
Agent 2 can receive Qdrant-retrieved course context.
The renderer can produce media and supporting artifacts.
An optional MCP integration exposes 25 tools.
